# Motion One (DOM)

- Package: `@motionone/dom`
- Version: `10.18.0`
- License: MIT (`LICENSE`)
- Official source: https://github.com/motiondivision/motionone
- Official documentation: https://motion.dev/docs

`animate-style.js` and `in-view.js` are the package's small standalone browser modules used for the Skills card reveal. They are served from this project, so rendering does not depend on a CDN or an install/build step. No React, Tailwind, or runtime package manager is required.
